stories.title: £200m carbon capture facility at Parc Adfer recommended for approval
stories.summary: A £200 million carbon capture facility which will collect almost a quarter of a million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year is seeking approval by Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Flintshire and Wrexham schools could face headteacher strike action after NAHT Cymru ballot
stories.summary: Schools across Flintshire and Wrexham could face industrial action from headteachers over funding for additional learning needs (ALN) and pay. Members of the National Association of Headteachers (NAHT) Cymru have voted overwhelmingly in favour of strike action if Welsh Government fails to improve wage conditions and pump more money into ALN support. stories.summary: Flintshire Council could spend money upgrading its last three public toilets and still face having to close them, a report has warned.
